paper_title: FreqKV Frequency Domain Key-Value Compression for Efficient Context   Window Extension
caption: : Perplexity evaluation on the validation set of PG-19 with different retaining ratios.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the perplexity (PPL) on the validation set of PG-19 as a function of the evaluation context length, for three different retaining ratios (y = 0.25, y = 0.5, and y = 0.75). The x-axis, labeled “Evaluation Context Length,” is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 2K to 64K, with tick labels at each power of two (2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K). The y-axis, labeled “PPL,” is also on a linear scale, ranging from 7.7 to 8.2. The blue line, representing y=0.25, starts at approximately 8.2 at 2K and decreases to about 7.8 at 64K, showing a steady decline with minor fluctuations. The orange line for y=0.5 begins at 8.2 at 2K, drops sharply to around 7.75 at 8K, and then stabilizes near 7.75 from 16K to 64K. The green line for y=0.75 follows a similar pattern, starting at 8.2 at 2K, falling to approximately 7.75 at 8K, and then remaining relatively flat at around 7.75 from 16K to 64K. All three lines are marked with circular data points and connected by solid lines.
